description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the PerformanceTrackerReviewerAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various API methods related to performance tracker reviewers, including retrieval and ensuring that create and delete operations are not implemented.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerReviewerAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PerformanceTrackerReviewerAPI endpoints, including tests for fetching all reviewers and validation of unimplemented create and delete methods.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' API endpoint for performance tracker reviewers, including setting up fixtures, mocking services, and asserting validity.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetAll' method using a YAML data file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the 'create' API method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for create are not implemented and throw exceptions.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the 'delete' API method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for delete are not implemented and throw exceptions.
